pieces.device: A cream case file on one Edmonton semi-detached house drawn in halftone, split by a red line down the party wall; the left and right halves are two faceless composite households labelled 'Illustrative example'; numbered exhibits (A: same mortgage, B: the letter, C: the rate cards) compare sides; stamps SIGNED (left, day 21) and SHOPPED (right, day 120); a fat halftone counter spins during the guess freeze and stops on the verdict.
